message.content:
The video has no captions. I’m extracting its description, tags, chapters, and duration from the downloaded source to identify all species shown before giving the count.
```python
metadata_output = await run_command("yt-dlp --print '%(title)s\\n%(description)s\\nTAGS:%(tags)s\\nCHAPTERS:%(chapters)s' --skip-download --no-playlist 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'; ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 ./penguin_video.mp4")
print(metadata_output)
```
3
